title: The Game Rule Bent toward Fair
youtube_title: The Game Rule Bent toward Fair | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Eitan is just outside the fun, close to rule you could bend so a new friend could really play. Jorie changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Eitan has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
